newsitem.title: USA: Crossmann Communities merger letter expires.
newsitem.headline: Crossmann Communities merger letter expires.

text.p: Crossmann Communities Inc said Thursday its letter of intent to acquire Don Galloway Homes Inc has expired.
Crossmann said the parties have been unable to reach agreement on material terms of a purchase agreement.
No further details were immediately available.

In late April Crossmann said it had agreed in principle to acquire homebuilder Don Galloway Homes and related business operations based in Charlotte, N.C., and planned to close the transaction early in the third quarter.
Crossmann is a builder of new homes in Indiana, Ohio, and Kentucky.
